prompts.hero_walk_run_grid: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for Human Last Rampart. Reference 1 is the ONLY identity/style authority: original selected hero, spiky white hair, large head about 1/3 height, blue eyes with white highlights, black charcoal officer coat with gold trim and thick gold fringed epaulettes, white shirt, brown belt, big brown boots, short sturdy body. Reference 2 is the approved 73-pixel scale. Reference 3 gives REQUIRED layout and movement order only, not smooth rendering style. Make exactly 16 fully separate sprites in a regular 4-column x 4-row grid, transparent background, equal spacing, no grid lines, no letters. Row0: BACK walking away four poses left contact, passing, right contact, passing. Row1: SIDE walking LEFT four poses left contact, passing, right contact, passing. Row2: SIDE running LEFT four poses left extended contact, left passing, right extended contact, right passing (keep one boot grounded per frame). Row3: FRONT walking towards viewer four poses left contact, passing, right contact, passing. Full character visible all frames; consistent head/body proportions and head position, feet share a baseline within every row. Emulate native ~73 px tall sprite with ~24 px head; chunky square pixel clusters, one-native-pixel dark continuous outline, about 3 shades per material, NO blur antialiasing gradient glow or shadows. Each grid slot same size and same central body axis. Hero is unarmed. Preserve the original hero's broad white spiky hairstyle and prominent gold shoulder silhouette. Output tall 3:4 sheet, transparent RGBA.
prompts.hero_command: Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel-art sprite sheet. Image 1 is the ONLY original approved character identity, Image2 is freshly made movement sheet to MATCH, Image3 is existing command sheet to preserve gesture order. Make exactly THREE full-body BACK VIEW sprites of this same white-haired officer, arranged horizontally in 3 identical equal-width cells on genuinely transparent background, no text no grid. Frame0 stands idle from behind, both hands lowered, both boots planted, symmetrical broad white spiky hair and two gold fringed epaulettes. Frame1 same body and head/boots exactly aligned, raises right hand beside head, bent elbow, preparing command. Frame2 same body and head/boots exactly aligned, right arm extends diagonally up and right to command/point, left arm lowered. Black charcoal coat, bright gold shoulder epaulettes and cuffs and tails trim, brown belt, short sturdy legs and large brown boots; white hair about one third of height, match original first reference. Native character about73px tall, head about24px. Thick 1-native-pixel dark outline, chunky square pixel clusters, about 3 shades per material. No gradient, blur, glow, ground shadow, weapon. BACK OF HEAD only, no face/eyes visible. Uniform head size and coat shape all3; feet same y in all3. Ample empty margin around every sprite. Prefer 3:2 landscape canvas.
